components.name: Primary acquisition button
components.description: Starts a primary camera action while preserving familiar button behavior.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid #3d91a7; border-radius: 6px; background: #236b7d; color: #f1f5f8; font: 620 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #73d1e6; background: #287c90; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #10171f; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fe6f3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Abort button
components.description: The only destructive control; always adjacent to connection and Preview.
components.css: .ds-button-abort { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid #865054; border-radius: 6px; background: #3f1c22; color: #ffb7b8; font: 620 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-abort:hover { border-color: #f06e70; background: #54252c; } .ds-button-abort:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fe6f3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-abort:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Instrument input
components.description: Compact numeric or textual entry in the acquisition rail.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; gap: 7px; flex-direction: column; color: #aebbc8; font: 12px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid #3d4d5e; border-radius: 6px; background: #0a0f15; color: #f1f5f8; font: 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #586b7e; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fe6f3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live status readout
components.description: A term and live measurement in the persistent status rail.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; margin: 0; border: 1px solid #293442; background: #0d1117; color: #f1f5f8; } .ds-status div { min-width: 100px; padding: 8px 14px; border-right: 1px solid #293442; } .ds-status dt { color: #8997a5; font: 650 11px/1.4 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .055em; } .ds-status dd { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #73d1e6; font: 12px/1.5 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Scientific image stage
components.description: The deep, image-majority viewport with a generation label and non-scientific stretch boundary.
components.html:
Generation 42
SCIENTIFIC IMAGE
Display stretch only · scientific pixels unchanged
components.css: .ds-viewport { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(240px, 1fr) auto; min-width: 440px; border: 1px solid #293442; background: #090c10; color: #f1f5f8; font: 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-viewport header, .ds-viewport footer { padding: 9px 14px; color: #8997a5; font: 11px/1.5 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-image { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #020304; color: #aebbc8; }

components.name: Operational log row
components.description: Escaped, aligned diagnostic output in the persistent bottom timeline.
components.css: .ds-log { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 190px 66px 1fr; gap: 10px; padding: 5px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #171e27; background: #0a0e13; color: #f1f5f8; font: 11px/1.5 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-log time { color: #8997a5; } .ds-log strong { color: #e4ac55; font-weight: 650; }

narrative.overview: This is an operating surface for acquiring and judging scientific images, not a dashboard assembled from interchangeable cards. The console feels like a precise optical instrument used in low ambient light. Expression comes from measured alignment, legible state color, dense but calm data, and the changing image itself.
keyCharacteristics: The scientific image is always the largest visual object.
Controls are grouped by acquisition sequence, not by equal-sized cards.
State, warning, and error colors carry operational meaning only.
Numeric data aligns for rapid comparison.
Logs remain visible, filterable, pausable, and exportable.

rules.name: The Signal Integrity Rule
rules.body: Accent colors never decorate neutral content; each colored element must communicate selection, activity, warning, or failure.

rules.name: The Measurement Type Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for values that operators compare or copy; actions, headings, and explanatory text remain sans-serif.

rules.name: The Image Majority Rule
rules.body: At workstation widths, the viewport owns more area than either side rail and cannot be reduced to a thumbnail by secondary panels.

rules.name: The Chassis Rule
rules.body: Resting panes share edges and tonal layers. Shadows indicate transient overlap or sticky state, never ordinary containment.

dos: Do keep connection, CameraState, RAW mode, temperature, and serial identity visible.
Do show loading, empty, disconnected, exposing, aborted, and failed states explicitly.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable contrast, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep display stretching visibly separate from scientific data and downloads.
donts: Don't reuse COSMOS66 device names, 8120 dimensions, HDR 18-bit, PICam, labeled gain modes, or 1/2/4-only binning.
Don't hide Abort inside a menu or modal.
Don't use equal-weight metric cards as the primary layout.
Don't invent stars, benchmark claims, customers, or decorative telemetry.
